Page 12 Cont.
Dec. 10 Joseph Carnaghi - 57 - cancerous tumor in bladder - doctoring about a year .... has helped a great deal in Charity-Guild. See Dec. 23rd. Marion Rochlean - 60 - skin trouble - would like to get well so as to hold a job.
Mary Diehl - 25 - serious Eye trouble ...
E'd Giddy - 45 - cancer feared - operation some time ago was aban- doned as hopeless - Sew'd him up ....
Gerard McDonald - 19 - from Nova Scotia - nerve trouble .... Mrs. McAndres. .
Page 13 Dec. 14 14 Antoinette Infantino - 14 - Very threatening cancer of leg. Dr's want to amputate whole leg ... one operation in examination Dec. 8th.
Gerald McGinty - 26 - wounded over in Germany Nov. 30th.
15 Rita (Martin) Thompson - 23 - acts very strangely at times - fears herself that she is possessed. At times she acts so - leaving her husband and three little ones and stays out all nite.
Fr. Rudolph O. F.M.Vsp. - in Tucson, Arizona -
Raymond Carey - 48 - heart and gall.
Mrs. & Mr. C. Miller - Twins To-day ... in serious condition.
21 Thomas Arthur O'Connell - 3 - nerve - serious heart trouble, in fact "incurable". .. Enrolled 2nd time To-day ... 5.
22 Lawrence Malicke - 19 mo. - though apparently healthy otherwise and appreciative has never had a normal apetite for food of any kind ... Enrolled in Ser. Masses and given candy eats it without hesitation.
Page 14 Dec.
Friends for Christmas Masses
Caroline Duffy
Rita Roney - 30 - slight nerve-break. .
